input-field.name: apiUrl
input-field.label: Trident admin API URL
URL der Trident-Admin-API
input-field.helpText: One Trident server. Several servers, or per-environment values, belong in the deployment config: the TRIDENT_INSTANCES environment variable takes precedence over this field.
Ein Trident-Server. Mehrere Server gehören in die Umgebungsvariable TRIDENT_INSTANCES, die Vorrang vor diesem Feld hat.

input-field.name: apiToken
input-field.label: Trident admin API token
Token der Trident-Admin-API
input-field.helpText: The [admin] auth_token of trident.toml, for the URL above. Stored encrypted and bound to that URL: after changing the URL, enter the token again. A TRIDENT_API_TOKEN in the environment is used only for instances from the environment (TRIDENT_INSTANCES / TRIDENT_API_URL), never for this URL.

input-field.name: purgeMode
input-field.label: Purge mode
Purge-Modus
input-field.helpText: soft: the next visitor still gets the old page while Trident fetches the new one in the background. hard: the entry is removed at once.

input-field.name: tagPrefix
input-field.label: Cache tag prefix
Präfix für Cache-Tags
input-field.helpText: Only when several shops share one Trident: a short unique prefix per shop (e.g. shop1_), so a purge or "clear all" never touches another shop.

input-field.name: esiEnabled
input-field.label: Header and footer as ESI fragments through Trident
Header und Footer als ESI-Fragmente über Trident
input-field.helpText: Trident caches the header and footer once each, so a menu change refreshes one fragment instead of every page. Only requests that come from Trident (see below) are served with ESI tags.

input-field.name: tridentPeers
input-field.label: Addresses Trident connects from
Adressen, von denen Trident verbindet
input-field.helpText: IP addresses, CIDR ranges or host names, comma separated. Default: this host (127.0.0.1, ::1). Requests from anywhere else are never served ESI tags.
